title: Bahmani Social And Cultural Aspects
definition: The Bahmani Sultanate (1347–1527) represented a unique synthesis of Perso-Arabic administrative traditions and indigenous Deccan cultural practices, fostering a distinct 'Deccani' identity.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Prelims regarding architectural styles, administrative terminology, and the socio-political divide between 'Afaqis' and 'Dakhnis'.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Bahmani Social And Cultural Aspects.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
